sources.title: Tripo AI 3D model Generator | Text & Images to 3D in Seconds
sources.snippet: Tripo is an AI-powered 3D model generator that creates high-quality 3D models from text descriptions or images in seconds. Simply type a prompt or upload a photo, and our AI generates a fully textured 3D model you can download and use immediately.
